headline: One Game Into the Dolan Era, the Counter Council Has Already Voted
verdict: One down, one new neighbor recruited, and Ken's respect currently measured at three points and one returned lager.

headline: Kansas State Brings Ken's Favorite Thing to Town: Evidence
verdict: The offense is real, the defense is a rumor, and a fourth-grader named Danny is the most emotionally mature person in this column.

headline: A 45-42 Tuesday Night, and Leo Reyes Is Ruined for Life
verdict: Forty-five scored, forty-two allowed, and one six-year-old from Arizona now permanently, irreversibly a Viking.

headline: Aloha Means Hello, Goodbye, and Three and One
verdict: A tidy win, a worried neighbor, and a trivia team that knows more about Honolulu than it wanted to.

headline: Ken Said 'Let's See It in Lubbock.' Lubbock Has Been Seen.
verdict: A gutsy road loss, a defense with a pulse, a kielbasa prophecy fulfilled, and one father in Florida with the best take of the week.

headline: Dallas, Dealt With: Vikings Bounce Back at SMU
verdict: Two wins in one day for Coach Mickey, a deli pickle as a warning shot, and one nice sentence from Ken that he'll deny under oath.

headline: Three Points Short in Boulder, and Sal Had the Clippers Ready
verdict: Close again, short again, and the only thing that got shut down more efficiently than the offense was Mickey's hairline.

headline: A Pierogi, a Viking and a Kansas Blowout Walk Into Halloween
verdict: A complete, comfortable win, a four-year-old dumpling with a full-size candy bar, and Ken watching the Ohio forecast through his fingers.

headline: Sorry, Dad: The Bobcats Came, Saw and Kept Scoring
verdict: Ohio taught the class, the Vikings took notes, and Mickey's daughter is now, officially, the enemy he'd give his life for.

headline: Cowboys Corralled: A Three-Point Answer to a 25-Point Question
verdict: A gutsy answer after the Ohio lesson, a bowl ticket punched, Chester on his feet, and Ken's first happy album in eight years.

headline: Orlando Was Warm, Sarasota Was Warmer
verdict: Seven wins, a pipefitter from Akron, and the best replay of the season, watched three times in a living room in Sarasota.

headline: 46-45. That's It. That's the Headline.
verdict: One point, five pierogi, one converted wife, one bet to collect from Nadia, and a doubter who will deny yelling until the end of time.

headline: Liberty Bowl Champions: Mickey's Closet Needs a Bigger Door
verdict: Nine wins, a bowl trophy, a Mackey Award, a crayon Viking on the fridge, and a doubter who said "Merry Christmas" in print, which is basically a confession.

headline: The Bazelak Is on the Board, and the Freshman Is in Charge
verdict: A freshman in charge, a sandwich on the board, and Ken's first secret compliment of the year delivered to a kielbasa.

headline: The Air Force Can't Fly Over This Defense, and Leo Reyes Has a Flag
verdict: Two wins, one flag pulled, and a jazz record that perfectly captures Ken's refusal to enjoy anything.

headline: Vikings Defeat an Entire Region, 56-13
verdict: Fifty-six points against a region, a sausage prophecy fulfilled, and the best laugh Ray Hogmanes has had all year.

headline: Louisville Is a City, and the Vikings Just Annexed It
verdict: Sixty-two points, a city annexed, a slicer silenced, and Nadia accidentally saying something nice.

headline: Houston, We Have a Five-and-Oh
verdict: Five and oh, a barber's grudge, and one piece of advice for a freshman quarterback from a father in Sarasota.

headline: Six and Oh in the Cornfields, and the Lunch Table Is Losing Its Mind
verdict: Six and oh in the cornfields, Chester has spoken, and Big Stan has a napkin under the register that Ken is legally prevented from describing.

headline: Boulder Again. Of Course It Was Boulder.
verdict: The undefeated dream ends in Boulder again, Donna makes tea, and Ken admits, very briefly, that he'd started to believe.

headline: Two Points, One Bobblehead, and a Bet Ken Will Never Let Go
verdict: A rivalry win by two, a green felt cape that refuses to come off, and one bobblehead turned toward the wall in Ohio City.

headline: Arizona Wins the Day, and the Counter Council Goes Quiet
verdict: A hard loss on a hard week, a quiet deli, and one white lie in Sarasota that was the kindest thing anyone did all Saturday.

headline: 56-38 in Athens: Mickey Texts His Daughter Back
verdict: Fifty-six in Athens, the storm passed, a "sorry, kiddo" a year in the making, and breakfast with the enemy, who is also family.

headline: Nine Wins, a Turned Pennant and an Eleven-Week Losing Streak at Trivia
verdict: Nine wins, a pennant facing the wall, a plaque for consistency, and a skull icon in a spreadsheet pointing straight at Manhattan, Kansas.

headline: Leftovers in Manhattan, Kansas: K-State Hands Us the Bill
verdict: A rough night in Kansas, a much better Thursday in Old Brooklyn, and a father in Florida who remembered the pierogi.

headline: Texas Bowl Champions, Ten Wins and a Number Next to Our Name
verdict: Ten wins, a Texas Bowl trophy, a number next to our name, a neighbor who now says "we," and a father in Florida who remembered.

headline: Year Three Opens With a Rout and a Freshman Named Cleveland
verdict: A rout to open year three, a five-star freshman with the whole city on his back, and Ken's band reunion indefinitely postponed.

headline: Tulsa? TULSA? Ken Has Never Been Happier to Be Miserable
verdict: A loss nobody saw coming, a spreadsheet in shock, a child's case against stairs, and the right advice from a man who thought it was about fishing.

headline: A Shootout Win, an Engagement Ring and a Carpenter Who Asked First
verdict: A bounce-back win, a carpenter with manners, and a free ring of kielbasa that may be legally binding in Slavic Village.

headline: The Boulder Curse Is Broken, and Ken Put On a Happy Record
verdict: Boulder conquered at last, Sal's Bermuda Triangle closed, and Ken's neighbor upgraded to full sentences.

headline: Big Stan Names a Sandwich After a Freshman, and Middle Tennessee Gets the Leftovers
verdict: Four and one, a two-plate sandwich, a box carried out like a casket, and a five-game road trip looming like November weather.

headline: Lubbock, Revisited: The Road Trip Starts With a Payback
verdict: Lubbock repaid with interest, a spiral out of the hedge, and a Doom Model that has started answering in single words.

headline: 59-53 in Oxford: The Bobblehead Remembers, and So Does Ken
verdict: Fifty-nine points in Oxford, a bobblehead now staring at Ken, and four retellings of a basketball joke for the best audience in Sarasota.

headline: Halloween in Orlando, and Somebody Else Handed Out My Candy
verdict: A third straight road win on Halloween, a six-year-old Big Stan running the candy line, and one dignified "caw" in Ohio City.

headline: Four for Four on the Road, and Salt Lake City Is Very Clean
verdict: Four road wins in a row, a very clean city introduced to the cardigan, and a big band record sitting on Ken's shelf like a dare.

headline: One Point in Tucson, and Ken Finally Played the Record
verdict: Five for five on the road, one point in Tucson, a deli owner bench-pressing a columnist, and a big band record finally allowed to play.

headline: Ten Wins Before Thanksgiving, and the Whole Street Is Nervous About Saturday
verdict: Ten wins before Thanksgiving, a pennant that crept back around while nobody was looking, and a doubter who honestly doesn't know.

headline: One Point. Ohio. Two Days After Thanksgiving.
verdict: One point, a great game on the wrong side, a careful Thanksgiving prayer, and the one thing Ray Hogmanes will never forget about Ohio.

headline: Alamo Bowl Champions, Eleven Wins and a Camp Award With Our Name on It
verdict: Eleven wins, an Alamo Bowl trophy, a Walter Camp winner who didn't get cocky, and a door that's officially propped open.
